question: Does the streaming updater need anything the per-pixel GRU lacks? Two concrete gaps: spatial context (GRU is 1x1) and the irregular acquisition gap dt.

arms.gru_dt: GRU + learned embedding of real days between the last acquisition of the previous state and the last new acquisition (from the sealed contract dates)
arms.gru_sp: GRU gates see a 3x3 depthwise neighbourhood
arms.xattn: memory write by local 3x3 cross-attention (q,k dim 512) from memory tokens to new-observation tokens, gated residual (3.15M)

budget: parameters within 3.5M +- 15%; report params and step time
data: Sen12 4 dev folds (hiroshima, thrissur, chimanimani, newzealand), same manifests/decoders as MS-116; 3 updater seeds

rule.pass: an arm beats gru by >= 5 points of recovery (seed mean) in >= 3 of 4 folds
rule.fail: none does -> 'per-pixel recurrent update is sufficient on Sen12'; no architecture claim
rule.then: only a passing arm is carried to KuroSiwo
